    About me

    I 'm Marco Girardini, an amateur astronomer and graduand in Mechantronics Engineering from northern Italy.

    In this website you can find a collection of my astrophotos, mainly taken from the middle of the Po valley under an extremely polluted sky but sometimes shot from better (or exotic!) skies.

    Like any other engineer I love building stuff; I often create my astrophotography gears and that 's the reason fot the website name.

    Just click on the images and a short description with a few technical datas will appear!

    Enjoy the visit!
